name: juz40-plugins
description: Juz40 team plugins: product discovery, PRD -> Confluence, Jira decomposition

plugins.name: juz40-pm
plugins.description: Product discovery for the Juz40 LMS (changes, features, epics), everything except design: context document, task class (type, audience, Product complexity low/mid/high), brainstorm and grilling with must-ask questions and loops back, metric, PRD for people + PRD for agents in Confluence, owner and core PM approvals, Jira stories, sub-tasks and bugs, and PRD updates when decisions change.
